sources.title: NC Department of Insurance — Basic Homeowners Insurance (general policy terminology; Florida contract governs)
Florida DFS — Determine Your Coverage Needs

heading.en: Start with the policy, not just the premium
heading.ht: Kòmanse ak polis la, pa sèlman pri a

text.en: A home policy is a group of separate protections. Each has its own limit, conditions and exclusions. The declarations page summarizes your selections; the policy forms and endorsements explain what actually applies. This guide describes common homeowners coverage, not every policy available. Condo, renters, dwelling-fire and manufactured-home forms differ. Some insurers label personal liability and medical payments L and M rather than E and F. Always match the description, not only the letter.
text.ht: Yon polis kay se plizyè pwoteksyon separe. Chak gen limit, kondisyon ak esklizyon pa li. Paj deklarasyon an rezime chwa ou yo; fòm polis la ak andòsman yo esplike sa ki aplike toutbon. Gid sa a esplike kouvèti komen, li pa dekri chak polis sou mache a. Polis kondo, lokatè, kay lokatif ak kay prefabrike diferan. Kèk konpayi itilize L ak M olye E ak F pou responsablite ak depans medikal. Gade deskripsyon an, pa sèlman lèt la.

heading.en: Coverage A — The dwelling
heading.ht: Kouvèti A — Bilding prensipal la

text.en: Dwelling coverage concerns the house and attached components, such as an attached garage, when damaged by a covered cause. The limit should reflect a supported rebuilding estimate, not the mortgage balance, purchase price or land value. Example: a house bought for $450,000 might need a different amount to rebuild because land and construction costs are different. A covered kitchen fire causing $35,000 in eligible damage is assessed under the applicable deductible and settlement terms; Coverage A is a ceiling, not an automatic check for the full limit.
text.ht: Kouvèti sa a konsène kay la ak pati ki kole avè l, tankou yon garaj atache, lè yon koz polis la kouvri domaje yo. Limit la dwe baze sou yon estimasyon rekonstriksyon ki jistifye, se pa balans mortgage la, pri acha a oswa valè teren an. Egzanp: yon kay ki koute $450,000 ka bezwen yon lòt montan pou rebati paske teren ak konstriksyon pa gen menm pri. Yon dife kwizin ki lakòz $35,000 domaj elijib ap evalye selon dediktib ak kondisyon peman yo; limit A a pa yon chèk otomatik pou tout montan an.

heading.en: Coverage B — Other structures
heading.ht: Kouvèti B — Lòt estrikti

text.en: This commonly addresses detached structures such as a shed, fence or separate garage. Do not assume a pool screen, business-use building or rented outbuilding has the same protection. Example: covered wind damage to a detached shed may fall under B, while damage to the house falls under A. Ask whether the selected B limit is enough for all detached structures together and whether any special wind limits apply.
text.ht: Sa konsène estrikti ki pa kole ak kay la, tankou yon depo, kloti oswa garaj apa. Pa sipoze yon ekran pisin, yon bilding biznis oswa yon estrikti ou lwe bay lòt moun gen menm pwoteksyon an. Egzanp: domaj van ki kouvri nan yon depo apa ka antre nan B, pandan domaj kay la antre nan A. Mande si limit B ou chwazi a sifi pou tout estrikti apa yo ansanm epi si gen limit espesyal pou van.

heading.en: Coverage C — Your belongings
heading.ht: Kouvèti C — Bagay pèsonèl ou

text.en: Furniture, clothing and electronics generally fall under personal property coverage for covered losses. Jewelry, cash, collectibles and business property may have smaller special limits. Example: a $5,000 ring stolen in a covered theft might exceed the policy’s jewelry theft sublimit. Scheduling valuables can be worth discussing. Make a room-by-room inventory with photos and receipts; do not wait until a loss to estimate everything you own.
text.ht: Mèb, rad ak aparèy elektwonik anjeneral antre nan byen pèsonèl pou pèt ki kouvri. Bijou, lajan kach, koleksyon ak ekipman biznis ka gen pi piti limit espesyal. Egzanp: yon bag $5,000 yo vòlè ka depase soulimit polis la pou vòl bijou. Pale sou posiblite ajoute yon kouvèti espesifik pou objè ki gen anpil valè. Fè envantè chak chanm ak foto ak resi; pa tann yon pèt pou eseye sonje tout sa ou posede.

heading.en: Coverage D — Loss of use
heading.ht: Kouvèti D — Lè ou pa ka itilize kay la

text.en: When a covered loss makes the home unfit to live in, additional living expense protection may reimburse necessary increases in living costs within policy limits and time conditions. Example: if normal food spending is $600 and temporary displacement raises eligible food costs to $900, the extra $300 may be considered, not automatically the whole $900. Keep receipts and ask the insurer before committing to a long hotel stay. Evacuating without covered damage is not automatically an ALE claim; civil-authority provisions have their own triggers.
text.ht: Lè yon pèt ki kouvri rann kay la pa abitab, pwoteksyon depans lavi anplis ka ranbouse ogmantasyon nesesè nan depans yo selon limit ak delè polis la. Egzanp: si manje nòmalman koute $600 epi deplasman tanporè a fè depans elijib la monte a $900, se $300 anplis la yo ka konsidere, pa otomatikman tout $900 la. Kenbe resi epi pale ak konpayi an anvan ou angaje yon otèl pou lontan. Evakye san domaj ki kouvri pa otomatikman bay dwa ALE; dispozisyon otorite sivil yo gen kondisyon pa yo.

heading.en: Coverage E — Personal liability
heading.ht: Kouvèti E — Responsablite pèsonèl

text.en: Liability coverage can respond when you are legally responsible for a covered injury or damage to someone else’s property, including a defense subject to the contract. Example: a visitor alleges that a neglected step caused a serious fall. Report the claim promptly rather than promising payment yourself. Intentional acts, business activities, certain animals or other exposures may be excluded or restricted. An umbrella policy can add liability protection, but it has separate eligibility and underlying-limit requirements.
text.ht: Responsablite pèsonèl ka aplike lè ou legalman responsab pou yon blesi oswa domaj byen lòt moun polis la kouvri, ansanm ak defans selon kontra a. Egzanp: yon vizitè di yon mach eskalye ou pa t repare fè li tonbe grav. Rapòte reklamasyon an rapid olye ou pwomèt peye pou kont ou. Aksyon entansyonèl, aktivite biznis, sèten bèt ak lòt risk ka eskli oswa limite. Yon polis umbrella ka ajoute pwoteksyon responsablite, men li gen kondisyon elijibilite ak limit minimòm pa li.

heading.en: Coverage F — Medical payments to others
heading.ht: Kouvèti F — Depans medikal pou lòt moun

text.en: This is usually a smaller benefit for eligible accidental injuries to others, often without first proving your legal liability. It is not health insurance for you or the household. Example: an eligible guest injury produces $700 of medical bills; a $1,000 selected medical-payments limit may help, subject to the policy. This does not mean the company will pay any injury occurring anywhere on the property.
text.ht: Anjeneral sa se yon pi piti benefis pou blesi aksidantèl elijib lòt moun, souvan san yo pa bezwen pwouve responsablite legal ou anvan. Se pa asirans sante pou ou oswa moun nan kay la. Egzanp: yon envite elijib blese epi fakti medikal yo se $700; yon limit $1,000 ka ede selon polis la. Sa pa vle di konpayi an ap peye nenpòt blesi ki rive nenpòt kote sou pwopriyete a.

heading.en: Replacement cost, actual cash value and roof settlement
heading.ht: Pri ranplasman, valè aktyèl ak peman pou do kay

text.en: Replacement cost and actual cash value are different settlement methods. Depreciation may reduce an ACV payment; replacement-cost policies can still hold back recoverable depreciation until repairs are completed. Example: a sofa costs $1,500 to replace but has an illustrative depreciated value of $600. Its payment depends on the selected settlement basis, deductible and claim conditions. Check the roof endorsement separately: a payment schedule or roof restriction can change a claim even when the dwelling has replacement-cost wording.
text.ht: Pri ranplasman ak valè kach aktyèl se de fason diferan pou kalkile peman. Depresyasyon ka diminye yon peman ACV; yon polis pri ranplasman ka toujou kenbe depresyasyon rekiperab la jiskaske reparasyon yo fini. Egzanp: yon sofa koute $1,500 pou ranplase men valè apre depresyasyon li se $600 nan egzanp sa a. Peman an depann de metòd ou chwazi a, dediktib ak kondisyon reklamasyon an. Verifye andòsman do kay la apa: yon tablo peman oswa restriksyon do kay ka chanje peman menm si kay la gen kondisyon pri ranplasman.

heading.en: Deductibles — turn percentages into dollars
heading.ht: Dediktib — chanje pousantaj yo an dola

text.en: A hurricane deductible expressed as 2% generally uses the insured dwelling limit, not the amount of damage. Example: $400,000 × 2% = $8,000. For an illustrative $25,000 covered loss, subtracting that deductible leaves $17,000 before other settlement adjustments. Florida has special rules for hurricane triggers and calendar-year application. Keep records of prior hurricane losses and ask the insurer how those rules affect your claim. Also compare all-other-perils, wind/hail and any separate roof deductibles.
text.ht: Yon dediktib siklòn 2% anjeneral baze sou limit asirans kay la, li pa baze sou montan domaj la. Egzanp: $400,000 × 2% = $8,000. Pou yon pèt $25,000 ki kouvri nan egzanp sa a, apre dediktib la rete $17,000 anvan lòt ajisteman peman. Florid gen règ espesyal sou kilè dediktib siklòn nan aktive ak aplikasyon li pandan ane kalandriye a. Kenbe dosye pèt siklòn anvan yo epi mande konpayi an kijan règ sa yo afekte reklamasyon ou. Konpare dediktib lòt risk, van/grèl ak nenpòt dediktib do kay apa tou.

heading.en: Optional protection worth asking about
heading.ht: Pwoteksyon siplemantè pou mande sou li

text.en: Ask about ordinance or law for eligible code-related rebuilding costs; water backup for specified drain or sewer backups; equipment breakdown; service lines; scheduled valuables; and increased limits for mold or water damage where offered. None is automatically included. Inflation guard can adjust the dwelling limit over time, but a 3%, 4% or 5% setting does not certify that the initial rebuilding estimate is correct. Example: 3% on a $400,000 base is $12,000 of illustrative annual adjustment; confirm how the actual endorsement calculates increases and affects premium and percentage deductibles.
text.ht: Mande sou ordinance or law pou depans rekonstriksyon elijib ki soti nan kòd konstriksyon; water backup pou sèten dlo drenaj oswa egou ki remonte; pann ekipman; tiyo sèvis; objè valè; ak limit anplis pou mwazi oswa dlo kote yo ofri sa. Okenn pa otomatikman ladan l. Inflation guard ka ajiste limit kay la ak tan, men yon chwa 3%, 4% oswa 5% pa garanti premye estimasyon rekonstriksyon an kòrèk. Egzanp: 3% sou $400,000 bay $12,000 ajisteman anyèl nan egzanp lan; verifye fason andòsman reyèl la kalkile ogmantasyon yo ak efè li sou prim ak dediktib an pousantaj.

heading.en: The major gaps — especially flood
heading.ht: Gwo twou yo — sitou inondasyon

text.en: Standard homeowners coverage generally excludes flood, including storm surge and rising surface water. A storm can cause both wind and flood losses with different policies responding. Wear, neglect, long-term leakage and maintenance problems are commonly excluded or limited; sinkhole, earth movement and mold provisions need separate review. Do not assume that the word water means every water event is covered. Example: a sudden covered pipe break, a backed-up drain and water entering from a flooded street can produce three different coverage decisions.
text.ht: Polis kay estanda anjeneral eskli inondasyon, tankou monte lanmè pandan tanpèt ak dlo sifas k ap monte. Yon tanpèt ka lakòz domaj van ak inondasyon ki mande polis diferan. Izaj, neglijans, flit ki dire lontan ak pwoblèm antretyen souvan eskli oswa limite; dispozisyon sinkhole, mouvman tè ak mwazi mande verifikasyon apa. Pa sipoze mo dlo vle di tout evènman dlo kouvri. Egzanp: yon tiyo ki pete toudenkou, yon drenaj ki remonte ak dlo yon lari inonde ki antre nan kay la ka bay twa desizyon kouvèti diferan.

heading.en: Your next step — a side-by-side review
heading.ht: Pwochen etap ou — yon konparezon kòtakòt

text.en: Bring your declarations page, full endorsements, roof age, updates and a recent inventory to a coverage review. Write down A–F limits, all deductibles, water/roof restrictions, exclusions and settlement methods for each quote. Ask what changed before accepting a lower price. ME Shield can help explain insurance options; only the issued contract and insurer’s assessment determine coverage for a particular loss. All dollar examples above are hypothetical and are not quotes or promises of payment.
text.ht: Pote paj deklarasyon ou, tout andòsman, laj do kay la, amelyorasyon ak yon envantè resan pou revizyon kouvèti a. Ekri limit A–F yo, tout dediktib, restriksyon dlo/do kay, esklizyon ak fason peman pou chak quote. Mande sa ki chanje anvan ou aksepte yon pri pi ba. ME Shield ka ede esplike opsyon asirans; se kontra yo emèt la ak evalyasyon konpayi an ki detèmine kouvèti pou yon pèt espesifik. Tout montan egzanp ki pi wo yo se ipotetik; yo pa quote oswa pwomès peman.

title.en: Self-Employed? A Monthly Recordkeeping Routine That Makes Tax Season Easier
title.ht: Ou Travay pou Tèt Ou? Yon Woutin Dosye Chak Mwa pou Fasilite Sezon Taks

description.en: A practical system for organizing income, receipts, business mileage and questions for your tax preparer.
description.ht: Yon sistèm pratik pou òganize revni, resi, kilomèt biznis ak kestyon pou preparatè taks ou.

heading.en: Give every payment a place
heading.ht: Bay chak peman yon plas

text.en: Waiting until tax season turns small bookkeeping questions into a weekend of guesswork. Create one folder for each month with income, expenses, statements and questions. A spreadsheet is enough to start: date, customer or vendor, amount, category and business purpose. Keep a separate business account where practical, and record transfers without treating every deposit as sales.
text.ht: Tann sezon taks fè ti kestyon kontablite tounen yon wikenn devinèt. Kreye yon dosye pou chak mwa ak revni, depans, relevé ak kestyon. Yon tablo sifi pou kòmanse: dat, kliyan oswa founisè, montan, kategori ak rezon biznis. Itilize yon kont biznis apa kote sa posib, epi anrejistre transfè yo san ou pa trete chak depo kòm lavant.

heading.en: Reconcile income, not just tax forms
heading.ht: Rekonsilye revni, pa sèlman fòm taks

text.en: Compare invoices and payment-platform reports with your bank statement. Record cash payments too. A tax form is a reporting document, not your complete bookkeeping system. Example: a customer pays $200 and the processor deposits $194 after a $6 fee. Your records should explain the $200 sale and $6 processing cost rather than losing the difference. Do not report the same sale twice because it appears in two reports.
text.ht: Konpare fakti ak rapò platfòm peman yo ak relevé labank ou. Anrejistre peman kach tou. Yon fòm taks se yon dokiman rapò, li pa tout sistèm kontablite ou. Egzanp: yon kliyan peye $200 epi processeur a depoze $194 apre $6 frè. Dosye ou dwe esplike lavant $200 la ak frè $6 la. Pa konte menm lavant lan de fwa paske li parèt nan de rapò.

heading.en: A receipt needs a business explanation
heading.ht: Yon resi bezwen yon esplikasyon biznis

text.en: Save the receipt and add a short note about the business purpose. For mixed personal and business purchases, identify the business portion instead of deducting the whole bill. Keep mileage records for business travel and distinguish commuting. Equipment purchases may need a different tax treatment from routine supplies; flag them for review rather than guessing the deduction.
text.ht: Sove resi a epi ajoute yon ti nòt sou rezon biznis la. Pou acha ki melanje itilizasyon pèsonèl ak biznis, idantifye pati biznis la olye ou dedwi tout fakti a. Kenbe dosye kilomèt vwayaj biznis epi separe trajè nòmal pou ale travay. Acha ekipman ka bezwen yon lòt tretman taks pase materyèl woutin; make yo pou revizyon olye ou devine dediksyon an.

heading.en: Close the month in four passes
heading.ht: Fèmen mwa a nan kat etap

text.en: First download statements. Then match income. Next match expenses to receipts. Finally list anything unexplained. Example: a $75 debit you cannot identify belongs in the questions list, not automatically under office supplies. Back up the records securely and restrict access. Keep originals or reliable copies for the period required for the specific record; there is no single retention period for every tax document.
text.ht: Premye etap: telechaje relevé yo. Apre sa, matche revni yo. Twazyèm etap: matche depans ak resi. Finalman, fè lis tout sa ki pa klè. Egzanp: yon debi $75 ou pa rekonèt antre nan lis kestyon, li pa otomatikman materyèl biwo. Fè sovgad sekirize epi limite aksè. Kenbe orijinal oswa kopi serye pandan tan ki obligatwa pou kalite dosye a; pa gen yon sèl delè pou tout dokiman taks.

heading.en: Bring decisions to the appointment
heading.ht: Pote kestyon pou pran desizyon nan randevou a

text.en: Give your preparer a year-to-date income-and-expense summary, supporting records and a list of changes such as a new business partner or equipment purchase. Ask what needs more documentation and whether estimated payments should change. This workflow is an organizational example; deductibility depends on the expense, business use and current tax rules.
text.ht: Bay preparatè ou yon rezime revni ak depans depi kòmansman ane a, dokiman sipò ak yon lis chanjman tankou yon nouvo patnè oswa acha ekipman. Mande ki depans ki bezwen plis prèv epi si peman taks estime yo dwe chanje. Woutin sa a se yon egzanp òganizasyon; dwa pou dedwi depann de depans lan, itilizasyon biznis ak règ taks aktyèl yo.

title.en: USCIS Documents and Translations: Organize the File Before You Submit
title.ht: Dokiman USCIS ak Tradiksyon: Òganize Dosye a Anvan Ou Soumèt Li

description.en: How to organize identity records, complete translations and a final document check without confusing document assistance with legal advice.
description.ht: Kijan pou òganize pyès idantite, tradiksyon konplè ak yon dènye verifikasyon san konfonn asistans dokiman ak konsèy legal.

sources.title: USCIS — All Forms and Current Instructions

heading.en: Start with instructions for your exact form
heading.ht: Kòmanse ak enstriksyon fòm egzak ou a

text.en: A document checklist from a friend is a starting point for questions, not proof of what your case requires. Use the current USCIS page for the exact form and read its evidence instructions. Make columns for required item, person, original language, translation and completion status. Legal eligibility, filing strategy and unusual evidence questions belong with an immigration attorney or authorized accredited representative.
text.ht: Yon lis yon zanmi ba ou se yon pwen depa pou kestyon, li pa prèv sa dosye pa ou mande. Itilize paj USCIS aktyèl la pou fòm egzak la epi li enstriksyon prèv yo. Fè kolòn pou dokiman obligatwa, non moun, lang orijinal, tradiksyon ak estati preparasyon. Kestyon kalifikasyon legal, estrateji depo ak prèv espesyal dwe ale jwenn yon avoka imigrasyon oswa reprezantan akredite otorize.

heading.en: Keep the original-language document with its translation
heading.ht: Kenbe dokiman lang orijinal la ak tradiksyon li

text.en: Foreign-language evidence generally needs a full English translation and the translator’s certification of accuracy, completeness and competence. Check the particular instructions for additional requirements. A short summary is not the same as translating the full document. Include seals, annotations and reverse-side information where present; ask the translator to address unclear text rather than inventing it.
text.ht: Prèv nan lòt lang anjeneral bezwen yon tradiksyon Anglè konplè ak sètifikasyon tradiktè a sou presizyon, entegralite ak konpetans li. Verifye enstriksyon espesifik yo pou lòt egzijans. Yon rezime pa menm ak tradiksyon dokiman an antye. Mete so, nòt ak enfòmasyon sou do dokiman an kote yo prezan; mande tradiktè a trete tèks ki pa klè olye li envante l.

heading.en: Check names and dates carefully
heading.ht: Verifye non ak dat avèk anpil atansyon

text.en: Example: a birth record shows 04/07, but the translation writes July 4 without checking the source date format. That small mismatch can create confusion. Compare names, spelling, dates and parents’ information across the original and translation. Do not silently change a name to make documents match. Ask a qualified legal professional how to address genuine discrepancies.
text.ht: Egzanp: yon ak nesans montre 04/07 men tradiksyon an ekri 4 jiyè san verifye fòma dat orijinal la. Ti diferans sa a ka kreye konfizyon. Konpare non, òtograf, dat ak enfòmasyon paran yo ant orijinal la ak tradiksyon an. Pa chanje yon non an silans pou fè papye yo matche. Mande yon pwofesyonèl legal kalifye kijan pou trete vrè diferans yo.

heading.en: Build a file someone else can follow
heading.ht: Bati yon dosye yon lòt moun ka konprann

text.en: Use clear filenames such as applicant-birth-record-original and applicant-birth-record-translation. Check scans for cut-off edges, unreadable stamps and missing pages. Example: a two-sided document scanned only on the front is not complete just because the PDF opens. Keep a final copy of exactly what was submitted and the submission confirmation in a secure location.
text.ht: Itilize non fichye klè tankou aplikan-ak-nesans-orijinal ak aplikan-ak-nesans-tradiksyon. Verifye si scan yo koupe rebò, si so yo lizib ak si pa manke paj. Egzanp: yon dokiman ki gen de fas pa konplè si ou scan sèlman devan, menm si PDF la ouvri. Kenbe yon kopi final egzak sa ou te soumèt ak konfimasyon an nan yon kote sekirize.

heading.en: Know the boundary of document assistance
heading.ht: Konnen limit asistans dokiman

text.en: ME Shield’s role is document preparation assistance, not selecting your immigration benefit, representing you or guaranteeing approval. Ask a lawyer or authorized representative about eligibility, status, deadlines, prior denials or removal proceedings. Fees, form editions and filing methods can change; recheck the official form page immediately before submitting.
text.ht: Wòl ME Shield se asistans preparasyon dokiman, li pa chwazi benefis imigrasyon ou, reprezante ou oswa garanti apwobasyon. Pale ak yon avoka oswa reprezantan otorize sou kalifikasyon, estati, dat limit, refi anvan oswa pwosedi depòtasyon. Frè, edisyon fòm ak fason depo ka chanje; verifye paj ofisyèl la ankò jis anvan ou soumèt.

title.en: A Florida Small-Business Renewal Calendar You Can Actually Maintain
title.ht: Yon Kalandriye Renouvèlman Biznis Florid Ou Ka Kenbe Ajou

description.en: Separate Sunbiz filings, local receipts, insurance renewals and tax obligations in one practical calendar.
description.ht: Separe depo Sunbiz, resi lokal, renouvèlman asirans ak obligasyon taks nan yon kalandriye pratik.

sources.title: Florida Department of State — Annual Report Instructions
Florida Department of State — Update Your Information

heading.en: One business can have several clocks
heading.ht: Yon biznis ka gen plizyè kalandriye

text.en: An LLC filing does not replace every other business obligation. Create a calendar with the responsible agency, requirement, due date, preparation date, person responsible and proof of completion. Start from your actual registration and renewal notices rather than copying another company’s schedule. Requirements vary with location, activity and tax classification.
text.ht: Depoze LLC pa ranplase tout lòt obligasyon biznis. Kreye yon kalandriye ak ajans responsab, egzijans, dat limit, dat preparasyon, moun responsab ak prèv travay la fini. Kòmanse ak vrè anrejistreman ak avi renouvèlman ou yo olye ou kopye kalandriye yon lòt konpayi. Egzijans yo varye selon kote, aktivite ak klasifikasyon taks.

heading.en: Keep Sunbiz current
heading.ht: Kenbe Sunbiz ajou

text.en: Review the official annual-report instructions and your entity record. Check the registered agent, mailing address, managers or authorized persons and contact email. The report updates state records; it is not an income tax return. Confirm the applicable filing year, deadline and fees directly with Sunbiz. A formation year and the first annual-report year may differ.
text.ht: Li enstriksyon ofisyèl rapò anyèl la ak dosye antite ou a. Verifye ajan anrejistre, adrès lapòs, manadjè oswa moun otorize ak imel kontak. Rapò a mete dosye eta a ajou; se pa yon deklarasyon taks sou revni. Konfime ane, dat limit ak frè ki aplike yo dirèkteman sou Sunbiz. Ane fòmasyon an ak premye ane rapò anyèl la ka diferan.

heading.en: Add the obligations outside Sunbiz
heading.ht: Ajoute obligasyon ki pa sou Sunbiz

text.en: List city and county business tax receipts if applicable, professional licenses, insurance and any DBA renewal. Separately list federal and state tax filings that apply to your business. Example: renewing an LLC record does not renew an insurance license or tell your city about an address change. Verify each issuing authority separately; an update at one agency may not update another.
text.ht: Mete resi taks biznis vil ak konte si sa aplike, lisans pwofesyonèl, asirans ak renouvèlman DBA. Fè yon lis apa pou depo taks federal ak eta ki aplike. Egzanp: renouvle dosye LLC pa renouvle lisans asirans ni li pa avèti vil la ou chanje adrès. Verifye chak otorite apa; mete yon ajans ajou pa toujou mete lòt yo ajou.

heading.en: Use a preparation date before the deadline
heading.ht: Mete yon dat preparasyon anvan dat limit la

text.en: Suggested workflow: review each renewal 30 days ahead, collect documents and confirm cost, then verify completion before the due date. These are organizational reminders, not legal deadlines. Example: a policy expiring December 1 gets a November 1 review and a separate confirmation task. Store the renewal receipt and the updated certificate, not just a screenshot of a payment page.
text.ht: Woutin sijere: revize chak renouvèlman 30 jou davans, rasanble dokiman ak konfime pri, epi verifye li fini anvan dat limit la. Sa yo se rapèl òganizasyon, se pa dat limit legal. Egzanp: yon polis ki ekspire 1 desanm jwenn yon revizyon 1 novanm ak yon travay apa pou konfimasyon. Sove resi renouvèlman ak nouvo sètifika a, pa sèlman foto paj peman an.

heading.en: Make the calendar useful every month
heading.ht: Fè kalandriye a itil chak mwa

text.en: Choose one monthly review day. Mark an item complete only after checking the official record or receiving confirmation. Give a backup person a safe way to find the calendar, without sharing passwords in plain text. ME Shield can assist with filing organization; legal structure and tax treatment questions need appropriately qualified professionals.
text.ht: Chwazi yon jou revizyon chak mwa. Make yon travay fini sèlman apre ou verifye dosye ofisyèl la oswa resevwa konfimasyon. Bay yon moun ranplasman yon fason sekirize pou jwenn kalandriye a san pataje modpas an tèks klè. ME Shield ka ede òganize depo yo; kestyon estrikti legal ak tretman taks mande pwofesyonèl ki kalifye pou sa.

title.en: Before Infinite Banking: How to Read a Whole Life Illustration
title.ht: Anvan Bank Enfini: Kijan pou Li yon Ilistrasyon Asirans Lavi Antye

description.en: Learn to separate premiums, cash surrender value, death benefits and non-guaranteed projections.
description.ht: Aprann separe prim, valè racha, benefis lanmò ak pwojeksyon ki pa garanti.

sources.title: California Department of Insurance — Life Insurance Guide (general education)

heading.en: An illustration is a comparison tool
heading.ht: Yon ilistrasyon se yon zouti konparezon

text.en: Before discussing Infinite Banking, understand the insurance contract that would support the strategy. An illustration shows policy values under stated assumptions. It is not a bank statement or a promise that the non-guaranteed column will happen. IBC is a use of cash-value life insurance, not a separate government-approved account or a deposit product.
text.ht: Anvan ou pale Bank Enfini, konprann kontra asirans ki ta sipòte estrateji a. Yon ilistrasyon montre valè polis la anba sipozisyon yo bay. Se pa yon relevé labank ni yon pwomès kolòn ki pa garanti a ap rive vre. IBC se yon fason itilize asirans lavi ki gen valè kach, li pa yon kont apa gouvènman an apwouve ni yon depo labank.

heading.en: Read premiums and surrender values together
heading.ht: Li prim ak valè racha ansanm

text.en: Find the planned premium, how long it is payable and whether riders or extra payments are optional. Then find the cash surrender value available if you exit, not just the death benefit. Example: $6,000 of illustrative first-year premiums and $1,800 of surrender value do not mean $6,000 is available for immediate borrowing. Early access can be limited and leaving early can be costly.
text.ht: Jwenn prim yo prevwa a, pandan konbyen tan ou dwe peye li ak si rider oswa peman anplis yo opsyonèl. Apre sa jwenn valè racha ki disponib si ou sòti, pa sèlman benefis lanmò. Egzanp: $6,000 prim premye ane ak $1,800 valè racha nan yon egzanp pa vle di ou ka prete $6,000 touswit. Aksè bonè ka limite epi kite polis la bonè ka koute chè.

heading.en: Separate guaranteed and non-guaranteed columns
heading.ht: Separe kolòn garanti ak sa ki pa garanti

text.en: Ask the agent to point out every guaranteed value and the assumptions behind other values. Participating-policy dividends are not guaranteed. Example: a projection using current dividends can look stronger than the guaranteed scenario; compare both before judging affordability. Do not treat a projected result as a savings-account interest rate or compare it with an investment return without accounting for insurance costs.
text.ht: Mande ajan an montre chak valè garanti ak sipozisyon lòt valè yo. Dividann polis patisipatif pa garanti. Egzanp: yon pwojeksyon ki itilize dividann aktyèl yo ka pi bèl pase senaryo garanti a; konpare toulede anvan ou jije si ou ka kenbe prim yo. Pa trete yon pwojeksyon kòm to enterè kont epay ni konpare l ak rannman envestisman san konte pri asirans.

heading.en: Stress-test the plan
heading.ht: Teste plan an nan kondisyon difisil

text.en: Ask for scenarios with lower dividends, a delayed extra contribution and the borrowing pattern you actually expect. Would the premium still fit after a job change? What happens if you need cash in year two rather than year ten? Request the loan rate, rider charges, surrender conditions and tax-sensitive limits in writing. A hypothetical worksheet is a planning aid, not a personalized recommendation.
text.ht: Mande senaryo ak dividann pi ba, yon kontribisyon anplis ki anreta ak fason ou prevwa prete toutbon. Èske prim lan toujou antre nan bidjè a si ou chanje travay? Kisa k ap pase si ou bezwen kach nan dezyèm ane olye dizyèm ane? Mande to prè, frè rider, kondisyon racha ak limit ki gen konsekans taks alekri. Yon tablo ipotetik ede planifye, li pa yon rekòmandasyon pèsonalize.

heading.en: Decide whether the long commitment fits
heading.ht: Gade si angajman alontèm nan adapte

text.en: Review immediate cash needs, emergency savings, debt and the actual need for life insurance before committing. Whole life is not the right tool for every household. Keep the signed illustration and ask for periodic in-force reviews after purchase. ME Shield explains insurance options; a tax professional should evaluate tax consequences for your circumstances.
text.ht: Revize bezwen kach rapid, epay ijans, dèt ak vrè bezwen asirans lavi anvan ou angaje. Lavi antye pa bon zouti pou chak fanmi. Kenbe ilistrasyon siyen an epi mande revizyon polis an vigè regilyèman apre acha. ME Shield esplike opsyon asirans; yon pwofesyonèl taks dwe evalye konsekans taks selon sitiyasyon ou.

title.en: Predictable Bills Are Not Emergencies: Build a Simple Sinking Fund
title.ht: Fakti Ou Prevwa Pa Ijans: Prepare Yon Fon pou Yo

description.en: A practical way to set money aside for annual bills while keeping emergency savings separate.
description.ht: Yon fason pratik pou mete lajan sou kote pou fakti anyèl san melanje li ak epay ijans.

sources.title: CFPB — An Essential Guide to Building an Emergency Fund

heading.en: Give planned bills their own line
heading.ht: Bay fakti ou prevwa yo pwòp liy pa yo

text.en: A car registration, annual insurance premium or planned school expense can surprise your checking account even when it is predictable. A sinking fund is simply money reserved gradually for a known future expense. It does not require a special financial product. Keep the purpose clear so a scheduled bill does not repeatedly drain the money you intended for a true emergency.
text.ht: Enskripsyon machin, prim asirans anyèl oswa depans lekòl planifye ka siprann kont ou menm lè ou konnen yo ap vini. Yon sinking fund se senpleman lajan ou mete piti piti pou yon depans ou konnen. Ou pa bezwen yon pwodui finansye espesyal pou sa. Kenbe objektif la klè pou yon fakti planifye pa toujou vide lajan ou te mete pou yon vrè ijans.

heading.en: Use the amount and the time remaining
heading.ht: Itilize montan an ak tan ki rete a

text.en: Example: an illustrative $1,200 bill due in 12 months needs $100 per month. If it is due in six months, the target becomes $200 per month. Subtract anything already saved before dividing. These examples ignore account interest and price changes. Write the due date beside the target so you can adjust when a renewal notice arrives.
text.ht: Egzanp: yon fakti ipotetik $1,200 ki vini nan 12 mwa bezwen $100 pa mwa. Si li vini nan sis mwa, objektif la vin $200 pa mwa. Retire sa ou gentan sere anvan ou divize. Egzanp sa yo pa konte enterè kont ni chanjman pri. Ekri dat limit la bò kote objektif la pou ou ajiste lè avi renouvèlman an rive.

heading.en: Start with two or three categories
heading.ht: Kòmanse ak de oswa twa kategori

text.en: Choose the next few bills that cause the most disruption: insurance, car maintenance or school costs, for example. Use labeled savings buckets or a simple spreadsheet with a running balance. Keep near-term bill money accessible and review the account’s fees and protections. You do not need a separate paid app or a new account for every category.
text.ht: Chwazi kèk fakti ki deranje bidjè a plis: asirans, antretyen machin oswa lekòl, pa egzanp. Itilize ti seksyon epay ki gen non oswa yon tablo ak balans k ap mete ajou. Kenbe lajan fakti ki toupre yo aksesib epi verifye frè ak pwoteksyon kont la. Ou pa bezwen yon aplikasyon peye ni yon nouvo kont pou chak kategori.

heading.en: When the target does not fit
heading.ht: Lè objektif la pa antre nan bidjè a

text.en: Suppose the calculation calls for $200 but you can spare $80. Record the $120 monthly gap now, while there is time to change the plan. Consider reducing the planned expense, moving a discretionary purchase or discussing available payment terms. A smaller realistic contribution is more useful than a perfect target you immediately abandon.
text.ht: Sipoze kalkil la mande $200 men ou ka mete $80. Ekri diferans $120 chak mwa a kounye a pandan gen tan pou chanje plan an. Konsidere diminye depans planifye a, ranvwaye yon acha ki pa esansyèl oswa pale sou kondisyon peman. Yon ti kontribisyon ou ka kenbe pi itil pase yon objektif pafè ou abandone touswit.

heading.en: Review after every payment
heading.ht: Revize apre chak peman

text.en: After paying the bill, save the receipt, reset the target and check the next due date. Keep a separate emergency goal for unexpected setbacks; the CFPB’s emergency-fund guidance explains that purpose. This article’s budgeting worksheet is an original organizational example, not investment advice or a promise that a particular savings target fits everyone.
text.ht: Apre ou peye fakti a, sove resi a, rekòmanse objektif la epi verifye pwochen dat la. Kenbe yon objektif ijans apa pou kou di ou pa prevwa; gid CFPB sou fon ijans esplike objektif sa a. Tablo bidjè nan atik sa a se yon egzanp òganizasyon orijinal, se pa konsèy envestisman ni pwomès yon sèl objektif adapte pou tout moun.

title.en: Sending Money to Family in Haiti: Compare the Total Cost
title.ht: Voye Lajan Bay Fanmi Ayiti: Konpare Pri Total la

description.en: Look beyond the advertised transfer fee and compare what your family will actually receive.
description.ht: Pa gade sèlman frè yo fè reklam lan: konpare sa fanmi ou ap resevwa toutbon.

sources.title: CFPB — Sending Money to Another Country
CFPB — Remittance Transfer Disclosures, Regulation E §1005.31

heading.en: Begin with the family need
heading.ht: Kòmanse ak bezwen fanmi an

text.en: Helping family is easier to sustain when the transfer has a place in your household budget. Decide the amount and purpose before choosing the provider. Ask whether the recipient needs bank deposit, mobile delivery or cash pickup. An affordable transfer that cannot be collected conveniently may not solve the problem.
text.ht: Ede fanmi pi fasil pou kenbe lè transfè a gen plas li nan bidjè kay ou. Deside montan ak objektif la anvan ou chwazi konpayi an. Mande si moun nan bezwen depo labank, livrezon mobil oswa retrè kach. Yon transfè bon mache moun nan pa ka resevwa fasil ka pa rezoud pwoblèm nan.

heading.en: Compare the same transaction
heading.ht: Konpare menm tranzaksyon an

text.en: For a fair comparison, use the same amount, destination currency, payment method and delivery method at about the same time. Look at the total debited, fees, exchange rate, expected delivery and amount received. A zero-fee promotion can still deliver less because of the exchange rate. Do not assume an introductory offer is the regular price.
text.ht: Pou konpare jis, itilize menm montan, lajan destinasyon, metòd peman ak livrezon nan apeprè menm moman. Gade total yo pran sou kont ou, frè, to chanj, delè prevwa ak montan resevwa. Yon pwomosyon san frè ka toujou bay mwens akoz to chanj lan. Pa sipoze yon òf premye transfè se pri nòmal la.

heading.en: A simple hypothetical comparison
heading.ht: Yon senp konparezon ipotetik

text.en: Suppose you have a total budget of $105. Provider A charges $5 and converts $100 at an illustrative 130 units per dollar: 13,000 units. Provider B charges $0 and converts $105 at 122: 12,810 units. A delivers 190 more units in this invented example. These are not current Haitian exchange rates or provider quotes. Compare the actual disclosures before each payment.
text.ht: Sipoze bidjè total ou se $105. Konpayi A pran $5 epi li chanje $100 nan yon to ipotetik 130 inite pou yon dola: 13,000 inite. Konpayi B pran $0 epi li chanje $105 nan 122: 12,810 inite. A bay 190 inite anplis nan egzanp envante sa a. Sa yo pa to chanj Ayiti aktyèl ni quote konpayi. Konpare vrè enfòmasyon yo anvan chak peman.

heading.en: Confirm details through a trusted channel
heading.ht: Konfime detay nan yon kanal ou fè konfyans

text.en: Check the recipient name and delivery information before sending. If someone suddenly requests a new account or urgent payment, call a number you already know. Keep the receipt and transaction reference securely. Do not publish identification documents, receipts or account numbers in a community group to ask for help.
text.ht: Verifye non benefisyè ak detay livrezon anvan ou voye. Si yon moun toudenkou mande yon nouvo kont oswa peman ijan, rele yon nimewo ou te deja konnen. Kenbe resi ak referans tranzaksyon an an sekirite. Pa pibliye pyès idantite, resi oswa nimewo kont nan gwoup kominote pou mande èd.

heading.en: If the transfer goes wrong
heading.ht: Si transfè a gen pwoblèm

text.en: Contact the provider immediately and keep a record of the problem and response. Cancellation and error-resolution rights depend on the transfer and applicable rules; consult the CFPB’s current consumer guidance. ME Shield shares general education and is not acting as a money-transfer provider or recommending a specific company.
text.ht: Kontakte konpayi an touswit epi kenbe dosye pwoblèm nan ak repons li. Dwa anilasyon ak koreksyon erè depann de transfè a ak règ ki aplike; konsilte gid konsomatè CFPB aktyèl la. ME Shield pataje edikasyon jeneral, li pa aji kòm konpayi transfè lajan ni li pa rekòmande yon konpayi espesifik.

title.en: How to Compare Two Home Insurance Quotes Without Losing Important Coverage
title.ht: Kijan pou Konpare De Quote Asirans Kay San Pèdi Pwoteksyon Enpòtan

description.en: Use the same limits, deductibles and settlement terms before deciding which home quote offers better value.
description.ht: Itilize menm limit, dediktib ak kondisyon peman pou deside ki quote kay ki bay plis valè.

sources.title: Florida DFS — Determine Your Coverage Needs

heading.en: Start with matching information
heading.ht: Kòmanse ak enfòmasyon ki matche

text.en: A lower price is useful only after you understand what it buys. Give both insurers the same accurate home details: living area, construction, roof age, occupancy and updates. Ask for the rebuilding estimate behind Coverage A. Do not change facts or reduce a limit below an adequate estimate just to produce a cheaper premium.
text.ht: Yon pri pi ba itil sèlman lè ou konprann sa li achte. Bay toude konpayi yo menm enfòmasyon kòrèk: sifas kay, konstriksyon, laj do kay, itilizasyon ak amelyorasyon. Mande estimasyon rekonstriksyon ki dèyè Kouvèti A a. Pa chanje enfòmasyon ni diminye limit anba yon estimasyon adekwa jis pou jwenn yon prim pi ba.

heading.en: Compare each coverage line
heading.ht: Konpare chak liy kouvèti

text.en: Write A, B, C, loss of use, liability and medical payments side by side. Check valuables and water sublimits. Ask whether personal property and the roof use replacement cost, actual cash value or another settlement method. Example: two $400,000 dwelling limits can still produce different payments if one quote has a restrictive roof endorsement.
text.ht: Ekri A, B, C, pèt itilizasyon, responsablite ak depans medikal kòtakòt. Verifye soulimit objè valè ak dlo. Mande si byen pèsonèl ak do kay itilize pri ranplasman, valè aktyèl oswa yon lòt metòd. Egzanp: de limit kay $400,000 ka toujou bay peman diferan si youn gen yon andòsman do kay restriktif.

heading.en: Price the deductible difference
heading.ht: Kalkile diferans dediktib la

text.en: Example: on $400,000 of dwelling coverage, 2% is $8,000 and 5% is $20,000. Saving an illustrative $300 per year while accepting $12,000 more hurricane deductible is a cash-reserve decision as well as a price decision. It is not automatically good or bad. Check the specific deductible triggers and whether you could fund your share after a loss.
text.ht: Egzanp: sou $400,000 kouvèti kay, 2% se $8,000 epi 5% se $20,000. Ekonomize $300 pa ane nan yon egzanp pandan ou aksepte $12,000 dediktib siklòn anplis se yon desizyon sou rezèv kach tou. Li pa otomatikman bon oswa move. Verifye kondisyon ki aktive dediktib la ak si ou ka peye pati pa ou apre yon pèt.

heading.en: Read endorsements and exclusions
heading.ht: Li andòsman ak esklizyon

text.en: Ask about water damage, backup, ordinance or law, mold limits, screened enclosures, wind exclusions and flood. Confirm the insurer, policy form, billing fees and whether inspections or repairs are required before binding. A quote is a proposal; it is not proof that coverage has started. Ask for the effective date and written evidence of binding.
text.ht: Mande sou domaj dlo, dlo ki remonte, kòd konstriksyon, limit mwazi, ekran pisin, esklizyon van ak inondasyon. Konfime konpayi, fòm polis, frè peman ak si enspeksyon oswa reparasyon obligatwa anvan li antre an vigè. Yon quote se yon pwopozisyon; li pa prèv pwoteksyon an kòmanse. Mande dat efektif ak prèv alekri yo aktive polis la.

heading.en: Request an explanation of every change
heading.ht: Mande yon esplikasyon pou chak chanjman

text.en: Bring the current declarations and proposed quote to ME Shield. Ask for a list of improvements, reductions and unresolved questions. Keep existing coverage until replacement timing is confirmed so you can avoid an unintended gap. All figures here are hypothetical; the issued contract controls coverage.
text.ht: Pote deklarasyon aktyèl la ak nouvo quote la bay ME Shield. Mande yon lis amelyorasyon, rediksyon ak kestyon ki poko rezoud. Kenbe pwoteksyon aktyèl la jiskaske yo konfime dat ranplasman an pou evite yon espas san kouvèti. Tout chif isit la ipotetik; kontra yo emèt la kontwole kouvèti a.

title.en: Estimated Taxes for Self-Employed Workers: Plan Before the Bill Arrives
title.ht: Taks Estime pou Travayè Endepandan: Prepare Anvan Fakti a Rive

description.en: Understand why business income may need tax payments during the year and how to plan the cash flow.
description.ht: Konprann poukisa revni biznis ka mande peman taks pandan ane a ak kijan pou prepare lajan an.

heading.en: Revenue is not all spendable cash
heading.ht: Tout revni pa lajan ou ka depanse

text.en: A customer payment may need to cover expenses, taxes and your household income. Unlike a typical employee paycheck, self-employment receipts often arrive without tax withholding. Federal estimated payments may cover income tax and self-employment tax. Whether you need them depends on your overall situation, not simply whether you received a 1099.
text.ht: Peman kliyan ka bezwen kouvri depans, taks ak revni kay ou. Kontrèman ak anpil chèk anplwaye, revni travay endepandan souvan rive san yo pa retire taks. Peman federal estime ka kouvri taks sou revni ak taks travay endepandan. Si ou bezwen yo depann de tout sitiyasyon ou, pa sèlman si ou resevwa yon 1099.

heading.en: Estimate from profit and the full household picture
heading.ht: Estime sou pwofi ak tout sitiyasyon kay la

text.en: Start with a current income-and-expense summary. Your preparer also needs other income, withholding, filing status and relevant credits. A blanket percentage of every deposit can overstate or understate the need. Ask which calculation method applies, whether a prior-year safe harbor is available and whether uneven income calls for a different approach.
text.ht: Kòmanse ak yon rezime revni ak depans aktyèl. Preparatè ou bezwen lòt revni, taks yo gentan retire, estati deklarasyon ak kredi ki enpòtan tou. Yon pousantaj fiks sou chak depo ka twòp oswa pa ase. Mande ki metòd kalkil aplike, si yon règ pwoteksyon ki baze sou ane anvan disponib ak si revni iregilye mande yon lòt apwòch.

heading.en: An example of setting money aside
heading.ht: Yon egzanp mete lajan sou kote

text.en: Suppose a worker earns $4,000 in a month and has $1,500 of documented business expenses. The starting profit estimate is $2,500, not $4,000. If their preparer recommends reserving an illustrative 25% of that amount, the reserve is $625. This is arithmetic, not a recommended tax rate; the actual liability could be very different.
text.ht: Sipoze yon travayè fè $4,000 nan yon mwa epi li gen $1,500 depans biznis ki dokimante. Estimasyon pwofi debaz la se $2,500, li pa $4,000. Si preparatè li rekòmande sere yon 25% ipotetik sou montan sa a, rezèv la se $625. Sa se kalkil, li pa yon to taks rekòmande; vrè obligasyon an ka diferan anpil.

heading.en: Use official dates and payment channels
heading.ht: Itilize dat ak kanal peman ofisyèl

text.en: Check the current IRS estimated-tax schedule; the payment periods are not four identical three-month quarters. Disaster relief and individual circumstances can affect deadlines. Verify the correct taxpayer, tax year and payment type before paying through an official IRS channel, and save confirmation. A bank transfer alone does not tell you whether the payment was applied correctly.
text.ht: Verifye kalandriye IRS aktyèl la; peryòd peman yo pa kat trimès ki chak gen egzakteman twa mwa. Soulajman apre dezas ak sitiyasyon endividyèl ka afekte dat limit. Verifye kontribyab, ane taks ak kalite peman anvan ou itilize yon kanal IRS ofisyèl, epi sove konfimasyon an. Yon transfè labank pou kont li pa di si peman an aplike kòrèkteman.

heading.en: Revisit the calculation when income changes
heading.ht: Refè kalkil la lè revni chanje

text.en: Review after a large contract, job change, new spouse income or significant expense. Bring proof of estimated payments to tax preparation so payments are reconciled rather than forgotten. ME Shield can help organize tax preparation; this general explanation does not determine your required payment or guarantee freedom from penalties.
text.ht: Revize apre yon gwo kontra, chanjman travay, nouvo revni mari oswa madanm oswa gwo depans. Pote prèv peman estime yo pou preparasyon taks pou yo rekonsilye yo. ME Shield ka ede òganize preparasyon taks; esplikasyon jeneral sa a pa detèmine peman obligatwa ou ni li pa garanti pap gen penalite.

title.en: Your USCIS Receipt Notice: Track the Case Without Sharing Private Information
title.ht: Resi USCIS Ou: Swiv Dosye a San Pataje Enfòmasyon Prive

description.en: Keep receipt notices organized, use official case-status tools and recognize when you need authorized legal help.
description.ht: Òganize avi resi yo, itilize zouti estati ofisyèl epi rekonèt lè ou bezwen èd legal otorize.

sources.title: USCIS — All Forms and Current Instructions

heading.en: A receipt and an approval are different
heading.ht: Yon resi ak yon apwobasyon diferan

text.en: Receiving an acknowledgment does not by itself mean the requested benefit is approved. Read the notice title, applicant information and instructions carefully. Keep a copy linked to the exact filing. If a family submitted several forms, create a separate row for each receipt rather than assuming one status describes every application.
text.ht: Resevwa yon akize resepsyon pa pou kont li vle di benefis ou mande a apwouve. Li tit avi a, enfòmasyon aplikan an ak enstriksyon yo avèk atansyon. Kenbe yon kopi ki mache ak depo egzak la. Si yon fanmi soumèt plizyè fòm, kreye yon liy apa pou chak resi olye ou sipoze yon sèl estati dekri tout aplikasyon yo.

heading.en: Track only through verified official tools
heading.ht: Swiv sèlman nan zouti ofisyèl ou verifye

text.en: Use the receipt information in USCIS Case Status Online or your official USCIS account as appropriate. Type the official address yourself or use a trusted bookmark. Example: an unexpected message claims that paying an urgent release fee will approve the case. Do not pay from the message; check the official account and seek qualified help if the notice is unclear.
text.ht: Itilize enfòmasyon resi a nan USCIS Case Status Online oswa kont USCIS ofisyèl ou jan sa apwopriye. Antre adrès ofisyèl la ou menm oswa itilize yon favori ou fè konfyans. Egzanp: yon mesaj ou pa t atann di yon frè liberasyon ijan ap fè dosye a apwouve. Pa peye atravè mesaj la; verifye kont ofisyèl la epi chèche èd kalifye si avi a pa klè.

heading.en: Keep a small case log
heading.ht: Kenbe yon ti jounal dosye

text.en: Record the form, submission date, receipt, last official update, notice received and next action. Store the receipt number privately. Add a calendar reminder for an actual appointment or response date printed on a notice; do not create a legal deadline from a social-media estimate. Save envelopes and full notices, not only cropped photos of the first line.
text.ht: Anrejistre fòm, dat soumisyon, resi, dènye mizajou ofisyèl, avi resevwa ak pwochen aksyon. Kenbe nimewo resi a prive. Mete rapèl pou vrè randevou oswa dat repons ki ekri sou yon avi; pa kreye dat limit legal sou baz estimasyon rezo sosyal. Sove anvlòp ak avi antye, pa sèlman foto koupe premye liy la.

heading.en: Do not crowdsource a private file
heading.ht: Pa ekspoze dosye prive a nan gwoup

text.en: Before asking a general question online, remove names, receipt numbers, addresses, barcodes and identification numbers. A barcode can contain information even when nearby text is hidden. Better still, ask through a secure private channel. Never share a password or one-time sign-in code with someone offering to check your case in a public group.
text.ht: Anvan ou poze yon kestyon jeneral sou entènèt, retire non, nimewo resi, adrès, kòd ba ak nimewo idantifikasyon. Yon kòd ba ka gen enfòmasyon menm lè tèks bò kote l kache. Pi bon toujou, mande nan yon kanal prive sekirize. Pa janm pataje modpas oswa kòd koneksyon ak moun ki ofri tcheke dosye ou nan yon gwoup piblik.

heading.en: Escalate legal questions promptly
heading.ht: Chèche èd legal rapid pou kestyon legal

text.en: A request for evidence, denial, status issue or removal-related notice needs an immigration attorney or authorized accredited representative. ME Shield provides document preparation assistance only; it cannot interpret your legal options or guarantee timing or approval. Always follow the actual notice and current official guidance.
text.ht: Yon demann prèv, refi, pwoblèm estati oswa avi ki gen rapò ak depòtasyon mande yon avoka imigrasyon oswa reprezantan akredite otorize. ME Shield bay sèlman asistans preparasyon dokiman; li pa ka entèprete opsyon legal ou ni garanti delè oswa apwobasyon. Toujou swiv vrè avi a ak gid ofisyèl aktyèl yo.

title.en: LLC, DBA and EIN: Three Different Things a New Business Owner Should Understand
title.ht: LLC, DBA ak EIN: Twa Bagay Diferan yon Nouvo Mèt Biznis Dwe Konprann

description.en: Separate your legal entity, public business name and federal tax identifier before filing.
description.ht: Separe antite legal, non piblik biznis ak nimewo taks federal ou anvan ou depoze.

sources.title: Florida Department of State — Fictitious Name Registration
IRS — Get an Employer Identification Number
IRS — LLC Filing as a Corporation or Partnership

heading.en: Similar paperwork, different purposes
heading.ht: Papye ki sanble, objektif diferan

text.en: New owners often receive offers that bundle an LLC, a DBA and an EIN as if they were interchangeable. They solve different administrative problems. Write your legal name, intended public name, owners and activity on one page first. Then verify which filings apply rather than buying every service offered.
text.ht: Nouvo mèt biznis souvan resevwa òf ki mete LLC, DBA ak EIN ansanm tankou yo ta menm bagay. Yo rezoud pwoblèm administratif diferan. Ekri non legal, non piblik ou vle, pwopriyetè ak aktivite sou yon paj anvan. Apre sa verifye ki depo ki aplike olye ou achte tout sèvis yo ofri.

heading.en: The LLC is the state-law entity
heading.ht: LLC a se antite ki fòme selon lwa eta a

text.en: A limited liability company is formed through the state’s entity process. Its legal protections are not unlimited, and forming one does not automatically choose a particular federal tax treatment. Owner count and tax elections matter. Ask a lawyer about ownership and liability questions, and a qualified tax professional about classification.
text.ht: Yon limited liability company fòme atravè pwosesis antite eta a. Pwoteksyon legal li pa san limit, epi fòme li pa otomatikman chwazi yon tretman taks federal espesifik. Kantite pwopriyetè ak eleksyon taks yo enpòtan. Mande yon avoka kestyon pwopriyetè ak responsablite, epi yon pwofesyonèl taks kalifye kestyon klasifikasyon.

heading.en: The DBA is a registered public-facing name
heading.ht: DBA a se yon non piblik ou anrejistre

text.en: A fictitious name or DBA lets a business operate under a name different from the owner’s legal name where required. It does not create a second LLC or automatically grant exclusive ownership of the name. Example: Example Group LLC may use Example Neighborhood Services as its registered DBA; the DBA is not a separate company solely because it has a different sign.
text.ht: Yon non fiktif oswa DBA pèmèt yon biznis itilize yon non ki diferan ak non legal pwopriyetè a kote sa obligatwa. Li pa kreye yon dezyèm LLC ni bay dwa eksklizif otomatik sou non an. Egzanp: Example Group LLC ka itilize Example Neighborhood Services kòm DBA anrejistre li; DBA a pa yon lòt konpayi sèlman paske li gen yon lòt pankat.

heading.en: The EIN identifies an entity for federal tax purposes
heading.ht: EIN nan idantifye yon antite pou taks federal

text.en: An EIN is an IRS tax identifier, not a state business license or proof of insurance. The IRS issues EINs free directly; a preparer may charge separately for assistance, which should be clearly disclosed. For an LLC or corporation, follow IRS guidance about forming the entity first. Do not apply repeatedly because a paid advertisement made the official process hard to recognize.
text.ht: EIN se yon nimewo taks IRS, li pa yon lisans biznis eta ni prèv asirans. IRS bay EIN gratis dirèkteman; yon preparatè ka pran yon frè apa pou asistans, e li dwe esplike sa klè. Pou LLC oswa kòporasyon, swiv gid IRS sou fòme antite a anvan. Pa fè plizyè aplikasyon paske yon reklam peye fè pwosesis ofisyèl la difisil pou rekonèt.

heading.en: Use the right name consistently
heading.ht: Itilize non ki kòrèk la regilyèman

text.en: Keep formation records, DBA confirmation and the EIN letter together. Check which legal entity signs contracts, owns the bank account and is named on insurance. A public brand name alone does not settle those questions. ME Shield can help with administrative filings; legal advice, tax elections and trademark questions need qualified professionals.
text.ht: Kenbe dokiman fòmasyon, konfimasyon DBA ak lèt EIN ansanm. Verifye ki antite legal siyen kontra, posede kont labank ak parèt sou asirans. Yon non mak piblik pou kont li pa rezoud kestyon sa yo. ME Shield ka ede nan depo administratif; konsèy legal, eleksyon taks ak kestyon trademark mande pwofesyonèl kalifye.

title.en: Life Insurance Policy Loans: Interest, Repayment and the Risks to Understand
title.ht: Prè sou Polis Asirans Lavi: Enterè, Ranbousman ak Risk pou Konprann

description.en: Understand what borrowing against cash value means before using a policy loan in an Infinite Banking strategy.
description.ht: Konprann sa prete sou valè kach vle di anvan ou itilize yon prè polis nan yon estrateji Bank Enfini.

sources.title: California Department of Insurance — Life Insurance Guide (general education)

heading.en: You are borrowing under an insurance contract
heading.ht: Ou ap prete selon yon kontra asirans

text.en: A policy loan is generally an insurer loan secured by eligible policy value. You are not simply withdrawing your own deposit, and the loan is not automatically free. The contract determines availability, interest and how borrowing affects the policy. IBC terminology does not override those terms or turn the insurer into your personal bank.
text.ht: Yon prè polis anjeneral se yon prè konpayi asirans lan ki garanti pa valè elijib polis la. Se pa senpleman retire pwòp depo ou, epi prè a pa otomatikman gratis. Kontra a detèmine disponiblite, enterè ak efè prè a sou polis la. Mo IBC yo pa ranplase kondisyon sa yo ni yo pa fè konpayi an tounen pwòp bank ou.

heading.en: Interest is a real cost
heading.ht: Enterè se yon vrè depans

text.en: Example: a hypothetical $10,000 loan at a simple illustrative annual rate of 6% produces $600 of interest over one year before repayments or other adjustments. Actual accrual and rates depend on the contract. If unpaid interest is added to the balance, the obligation grows. Ask whether the rate is fixed or variable and how the insurer treats dividends on loaned values.
text.ht: Egzanp: yon prè ipotetik $10,000 nan yon to anyèl senp 6% bay $600 enterè nan yon ane anvan ranbousman oswa lòt ajisteman. Vrè kalkil ak to depann de kontra a. Si yo ajoute enterè ou pa peye nan balans lan, dèt la grandi. Mande si to a fiks oswa varyab ak kijan konpayi an trete dividann sou valè ki garanti prè a.

heading.en: Flexible repayment still needs a plan
heading.ht: Menm ranbousman fleksib bezwen yon plan

text.en: A contract may allow flexibility compared with a conventional installment loan, but premiums and interest obligations still matter. Example: using the policy to buy equipment does not make equipment revenue certain. Build a repayment plan that works if revenue is delayed. Compare the total cost and consequences with other borrowing options rather than assuming a policy loan is always cheaper.
text.ht: Yon kontra ka bay fleksibilite parapò ak yon prè nòmal ak vèsman, men obligasyon prim ak enterè toujou enpòtan. Egzanp: itilize polis la pou achte ekipman pa garanti ekipman an ap bay revni. Prepare yon plan ranbousman ki mache menm si revni an anreta. Konpare tout depans ak konsekans ak lòt opsyon prete olye ou sipoze prè polis toujou pi bon mache.

heading.en: Watch the effect on benefits and policy survival
heading.ht: Siveye efè sou benefis ak kontinite polis la

text.en: Outstanding loans and interest can reduce the amount beneficiaries receive. Excessive borrowing can threaten policy continuation. Ask for an in-force illustration showing the loan, interest and a stressed scenario. A lapse or surrender with debt can create tax consequences. Modified endowment contracts have different distribution tax rules; get qualified tax advice before treating access as tax-free.
text.ht: Prè ak enterè ki rete ka diminye sa benefisyè yo resevwa. Twòp prè ka menase kontinite polis la. Mande yon ilistrasyon polis an vigè ki montre prè, enterè ak yon senaryo difisil. Yon polis ki tonbe oswa ou rachte pandan gen dèt ka gen konsekans taks. Kontra MEC gen lòt règ taks sou distribisyon; pran konsèy taks kalifye anvan ou trete aksè a kòm san taks.

heading.en: Review before and after borrowing
heading.ht: Revize anvan ak apre ou prete

text.en: Ask for a written loan quote, available amount, interest terms, policy impact and repayment instructions. Then review the balance with each statement. ME Shield explains insurance mechanics; this article is not a loan offer, investment recommendation or promise of tax-free income. Numbers are hypothetical and do not represent an insurer’s current rate.
text.ht: Mande yon quote prè alekri, montan disponib, kondisyon enterè, efè sou polis ak enstriksyon ranbousman. Apre sa revize balans lan ak chak relevé. ME Shield esplike fonksyònman asirans; atik sa a pa yon òf prè, rekòmandasyon envestisman oswa pwomès revni san taks. Chif yo ipotetik, yo pa to aktyèl yon konpayi.

title.en: A Year-End Family Financial Checkup in Five Practical Steps
title.ht: Yon Revizyon Finans Fanmi nan Fen Ane a an Senk Etap Pratik

description.en: Review cash flow, savings, insurance documents and upcoming tax questions before the new year.
description.ht: Revize lajan k ap antre ak sòti, epay, dokiman asirans ak kestyon taks anvan nouvo ane a.

sources.title: CFPB — An Essential Guide to Building an Emergency Fund

heading.en: Review what changed, not just the balance
heading.ht: Revize sa ki chanje, pa sèlman balans lan

text.en: Choose a quiet hour and list changes since the last review: income, household members, housing, debt and business activity. Use current statements rather than estimates from memory. The goal is a short action list your family can complete, not a judgment about how much you should already have saved.
text.ht: Chwazi yon èdtan trankil epi fè lis sa ki chanje depi dènye revizyon an: revni, moun nan kay la, lojman, dèt ak aktivite biznis. Itilize relevé aktyèl olye estimasyon nan memwa. Objektif la se yon ti lis aksyon fanmi ou ka fè, se pa jije konbyen ou ta dwe gentan sere.

heading.en: Step one and two: cash flow and reserves
heading.ht: Premye ak dezyèm etap: bidjè ak rezèv

text.en: Compare actual monthly income with essential bills and irregular expenses. Then check accessible emergency savings. Example: $2,400 reserved against $3,000 of essential monthly expenses equals 0.8 month of those expenses. That is a description, not a universal target. Choose a next contribution you can sustain and separate planned bills from unplanned setbacks.
text.ht: Konpare vrè revni chak mwa ak fakti esansyèl ak depans iregilye. Apre sa verifye epay ijans ou ka jwenn. Egzanp: $2,400 rezèv parapò ak $3,000 depans esansyèl chak mwa egal 0.8 mwa depans sa yo. Sa se yon deskripsyon, se pa yon objektif obligatwa pou tout moun. Chwazi yon kontribisyon ou ka kenbe epi separe fakti planifye ak kou di ou pa prevwa.

heading.en: Step three: protection and beneficiaries
heading.ht: Twazyèm etap: pwoteksyon ak benefisyè

text.en: Collect current insurance declarations and life policy statements. Check whether a move, new child, marriage or other change calls for a review. Verify beneficiary information directly with each insurer rather than assuming a will or a conversation updated the policy. Ask a qualified professional about minors, trusts or complicated family arrangements.
text.ht: Rasanble deklarasyon asirans ak relevé polis lavi aktyèl. Gade si demenajman, nouvo pitit, maryaj oswa lòt chanjman mande revizyon. Verifye enfòmasyon benefisyè dirèkteman ak chak konpayi olye ou sipoze yon testaman oswa konvèsasyon te mete polis la ajou. Mande yon pwofesyonèl kalifye sou minè, trust oswa sitiyasyon fanmi konplike.

heading.en: Step four: tax questions before filing season
heading.ht: Katriyèm etap: kestyon taks anvan sezon depo

text.en: Organize income records, business expenses if applicable and proof of tax payments. List changes for your preparer and ask whether an estimate or withholding review is useful. Do not rush a purchase solely because someone online called it a write-off. A deduction does not reimburse the entire purchase price.
text.ht: Òganize dosye revni, depans biznis si sa aplike ak prèv peman taks. Fè lis chanjman pou preparatè a epi mande si yon revizyon taks estime oswa withholding itil. Pa prese achte yon bagay sèlman paske yon moun sou entènèt rele li write-off. Yon dediksyon pa ranbouse tout pri acha a.

heading.en: Step five: assign three actions
heading.ht: Senkyèm etap: bay twa aksyon

text.en: Finish with no more than three next actions, an owner and a date. Example: update an insurance contact, reserve $40 per payday and schedule a tax-record review. Keep sensitive files in a secure location a trusted person knows how to find. ME Shield’s educational review is not an investment plan or personalized legal or tax advice.
text.ht: Fini ak pa plis pase twa pwochen aksyon, yon moun responsab ak yon dat. Egzanp: mete kontak asirans ajou, sere $40 chak jou peman epi pwograme yon revizyon dosye taks. Kenbe fichye sansib kote ki sekirize yon moun ou fè konfyans konnen kijan pou jwenn. Revizyon edikatif ME Shield la pa yon plan envestisman ni konsèy legal oswa taks pèsonalize.

title.en: A Family Emergency Document Kit: Help Your Loved Ones Find What Matters
title.ht: Yon Dosye Dokiman Ijans Fanmi: Ede Pwòch Ou Jwenn Sa Ki Enpòtan

description.en: Create a secure, bilingual guide to important contacts and documents without putting private information in public.
description.ht: Kreye yon gid bileng sekirize pou kontak ak dokiman enpòtan san ekspoze enfòmasyon prive.

sources.title: Michigan Government — Financial Preparedness and FEMA EFFAK Resources

heading.en: Start with access, not a pile of papers
heading.ht: Kòmanse ak aksè, pa yon pil papye

text.en: In an emergency, a family may know that insurance and documents exist but not where to find them. Make a one-page index of important contacts and document locations. Write short instructions in the language your trusted person understands. Keep the index private and leave passwords, identification numbers and detailed medical information out of any broadly shared copy.
text.ht: Nan yon ijans, fanmi ka konnen gen asirans ak dokiman men yo pa konnen kote pou jwenn yo. Fè yon endèks yon paj ak kontak enpòtan ak kote dokiman yo ye. Ekri ti enstriksyon nan lang moun ou fè konfyans lan konprann. Kenbe endèks la prive epi pa mete modpas, nimewo idantifikasyon ak detay medikal nan kopi ki pataje lajman.

heading.en: Organize by the problem someone must solve
heading.ht: Òganize selon pwoblèm moun nan dwe rezoud

text.en: Suggested sections are household contacts, insurance, housing and vehicles, tax records and essential personal documents. List the organization, a verified contact method and the secure location of the complete record. Example: insurance — current declarations in the encrypted family folder — call the insurer using the number printed on the policy. That is more useful than an unlabeled stack of old quotes.
text.ht: Seksyon sijere yo se kontak kay, asirans, lojman ak machin, dosye taks ak dokiman pèsonèl esansyèl. Mete òganizasyon, yon kontak verifye ak kote dosye konplè a ye an sekirite. Egzanp: asirans — deklarasyon aktyèl nan dosye fanmi chifre — rele konpayi an nan nimewo sou polis la. Sa pi itil pase yon pil ansyen quote san etikèt.

heading.en: Keep copies secure and current
heading.ht: Kenbe kopi yo sekirize ak ajou

text.en: Choose protected digital storage with strong authentication and a safe physical backup where appropriate. Test whether the trusted person can find the index without giving them unrestricted access to everything. Do not leave a USB drive of identity documents in a car or send a full document kit into a group chat. Record the last update date.
text.ht: Chwazi depo dijital pwoteje ak bon otantifikasyon ak yon sovgad fizik sekirize kote sa apwopriye. Teste si moun ou fè konfyans lan ka jwenn endèks la san ou pa bay li aksè san limit nan tout bagay. Pa kite yon kle USB ak pyès idantite nan machin ni voye tout dosye a nan yon gwoup. Ekri dat dènye mizajou a.

heading.en: Information access is not legal authority
heading.ht: Aksè enfòmasyon pa otorite legal

text.en: Knowing where an account is does not automatically authorize someone to transact, sign or make decisions for you. Ask an attorney about powers of attorney, health directives and estate documents appropriate to your situation. Immigration matters need authorized legal help too. ME Shield can organize documents but does not create legal authority by preparing an index.
text.ht: Konnen kote yon kont ye pa otomatikman otorize yon moun fè tranzaksyon, siyen oswa pran desizyon pou ou. Mande yon avoka sou pwokirasyon, direktiv sante ak dokiman siksesyon ki adapte pou ou. Dosye imigrasyon bezwen èd legal otorize tou. ME Shield ka òganize dokiman men prepare yon endèks pa kreye otorite legal.

heading.en: Do a short family walkthrough
heading.ht: Fè yon ti demonstrasyon ak fanmi an

text.en: Show the trusted person how to find the index, verify official contact details and recognize outdated documents. Review after a move, new policy or important family change. This kit is an original organizational example informed by public preparedness resources; it is not a substitute for legal planning or individualized professional advice.
text.ht: Montre moun ou fè konfyans lan kijan pou jwenn endèks la, verifye kontak ofisyèl ak rekonèt dokiman ki pa ajou. Revize apre demenajman, nouvo polis oswa gwo chanjman fanmi. Dosye sa a se yon egzanp òganizasyon orijinal ki baze sou resous preparasyon piblik; li pa ranplase planifikasyon legal ni konsèy pwofesyonèl pèsonalize.
